githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.2 adds native message forwarding, a native GIF picker, a redesigned media viewer, saved-account switching, channel category settings, and server context menus. It also improves startup and large-account performance, message history, member lists, authentication, and Gateway reliability.

## Messaging and attachments

- Added native message forwarding with destination search, message previews, and support for channels, threads, and forum posts.
- Added compact timestamps when hovering over messages.
- Automatically loaded more message history when the initial results did not fill the timeline.
- Fixed replies in forum posts and threads.
- Fixed composer file attachments and enforced upload-size limits before transmission.
- Fixed Markdown link rendering, hover targets, and spoiler-label alignment.

## GIFs and media

- Added a native GIF picker with a responsive masonry layout.
- Improved GIF rendering performance and media loading behavior.
- Redesigned the media viewer with thumbnail navigation, expanded actions, and image context menus.
- Unified image-opening behavior throughout the app.
- Prevented horizontal timeline rubber-banding.

## Accounts, profiles, and member lists

- Added a native interface for switching between saved accounts.
- Improved sign-in and QR sign-in when installation identity information is unavailable.
- Replaced the member inspector with native member-list and profile presentation.
- Improved member activities, custom status emoji, profile effects, tags, and hover behavior.
- Fixed blank and repeated profile popovers.
- Improved member-list pagination, initial loading, guild re-entry, and permission-scoped loading.

## Servers and navigation

- Added channel category settings.
- Added server context menus while preserving unread state.
- Improved handling for inaccessible channels and unavailable profiles.
- Fixed guild-join reconciliation for initial and live session state.
- Improved startup restoration of unread state and channel access.

## Performance and reliability

- Reduced startup contention and refined loading skeletons.
- Improved responsiveness for large accounts, long timelines, media-heavy conversations, and the message-forwarding menu.
- Prioritized visible timeline media and cancelled obsolete loading work.
- Improved workspace caching while keeping persisted state isolated between accounts.
- Strengthened Gateway lifecycle reconciliation, authentication state, Discord bootstrap behavior, and API diagnostics privacy.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.1...v0.1.2](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.1...v0.1.2)

**Message forwarding, GIFs, and a redesigned media viewer 🌸**

**Highlights**
- Native message forwarding with destination search and previews
- GIF search and sending from a native masonry-grid picker
- Redesigned media browsing with thumbnails and expanded actions
- Saved-account switching from a dedicated native interface

- Faster startup, smoother timelines, and more reliable member lists
